    with open("memory.txt", "r") as file:
        return file.read() / 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        print("Usage: python divide_by_zero.py <text>\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    text = sys.argv[1]
    print_memory_contents(text)
```

This program uses the `with` statement to open the file and read its contents. The `divide_by_zero` function takes the text as input and returns the modified text. The `sys.argv` list contains the command-line arguments passed to the program.
